items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erwerbsminderungsrente
items.quote: Wer mit diesem Bescheid nicht einverstanden ist, kann ihn mit dem Widerspruch anfechten; dafür steht ab der Bekanntgabe ein Monat zur Verfügung.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 2027-09-29, presumed mailed same day. Under the postal delivery fiction (§37 Abs. 2 SGB X, now 4 days after the 2024/2025 reform of the Zugangsfiktion, previously 3 days): +4 days = Sun 2027-10-03, which is also Tag der Deutschen Einheit (national holiday). +3 days (old rule) = Sat 2027-10-02. Either way, since the computed day falls on a Saturday/holiday Sunday, delivery is fictionally deemed to occur on the next business day, which is Mon 2027-10-04 under both the 3-day and 4-day variants – so Bekanntgabe = 2027-10-04 regardless of which rule applies. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§187 Abs.1 BGB, via §26 SGB X): start = 2027-10-05. Per §188 Abs.2 BGB a one-month period starting the day after an event ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the event day (Bekanntgabe = 2027-10-04), i.e. 2027-11-04. That day (Thursday) is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so no further shift (§193 BGB) is needed.

warnings: The deadline calculation assumes the letter was actually handed to the post on its printed date (29.09.2027); if the envelope postmark or actual receipt date differs, the Widerspruchsfrist end date would shift accordingly and should be re-checked against the envelope.
